item.title: Introducing Workflow-Aligned Modules in the HiddenLayer AI Security Platform
item.description:
Author: Arman Abdulhayoglu
Date: December 22, 2025
Tags: ["AI Security", "Software Updates", "Platform Development", "Cybersecurity", "Enterprise Software"]
Summary:
  • HiddenLayer updated its AI Security Platform with workflow-aligned modules.
  • The Console features a unified Security Dashboard and improved navigation.
  • Modules now map directly to AI lifecycle stages.
  • Exportable data and a new Learning Center support teams.
  • Usability and performance enhancements improve daily operations.
  • The platform aims for end-to-end AI security and continuous improvement.

item.title: What are Secret Knowledge Defenses?
item.description:
Author: Alessandro Pignati
Date: December 22, 2025
Tags: ["AI Security", "Prompt Injection", "Language Models", "Cybersecurity", "Machine Learning Defenses"]
Summary:
  • Prompt injection exploits how language models interpret instructions.
  • Traditional defenses often fail against indirect attacks.
  • Secret knowledge defenses embed hidden signals in prompts.
  • These signals help detect if the model's behavior changes.
  • Attackers cannot see or manipulate these hidden instructions.
  • This approach assumes secrecy protects the model's integrity.

item.title: Red Teaming BrowseSafe: Prompt Injection Risks in Perplexity’s Open-Source Model
item.description:
Author: Ophir Dror, Or Oxenberg, Eliran Suisa
Date: December 21, 2025
Tags: ["AI Security", "Open Source Software", "Prompt Injection", "Cybersecurity", "AI Browser Models"]
Summary:
  • BrowseSafe is an open-source model to secure AI browsers.
  • We tested it for prompt injection vulnerabilities.
  • Some security mechanisms are effective but not foolproof.
  • Attackers can still manipulate AI behavior.
  • We recommend ongoing research to improve AI security.
